description: 12-25 related memory snippets (with in-set updates, restatements, trivia, TR/DE lines) -> topic summary <= 200 words plus atomic facts. Scored by gold fact key coverage, hallucinated specific tokens and length.
changelog: v1: removed bare-number key variants that match dates (review before blind pass)

cases.rationale: Plain fact list with one restatement and one trivia item.

snippets.text: orbitq retries a failing job with exponential backoff starting at 2 s.
The retry cap is max_attempts = 5; after that the job lands in jobs_dead.
Dead-lettered jobs raise an alert in the queue-alerts channel.
Backoff doubles with each attempt and is capped at 5 minutes.
Someone asked whether jitter is applied: yes, a jitter of 20% is added to every delay.
Per-job overrides use the @job(max_attempts=...) decorator.
Lunch order for the Friday retro is pizza.
Reminder: max_attempts is 5 by default.
jobs_dead rows are kept for 30 days and then purged by a nightly task.
Replaying a dead job: orbitq replay <job_id> moves it back to ready with attempts reset.
The retry counter is stored in the attempts column of the jobs table.
Payment webhooks are excluded from retries because the provider retries on its own.

cases.rationale: Storage facts plus a German trivia line and a restatement.

snippets.text: ledgerd renders invoice PDFs with WeasyPrint inside the render worker.
Rendered PDFs are uploaded to the bucket invoices-archive under yyyy/mm/ prefixes.
The bucket is versioned, so an overwritten PDF can be restored.
Objects older than 400 days move to the cold tier via a lifecycle rule.
Temporary renders live in /var/lib/ledgerd/tmp and are deleted after upload.
Invoice numbers follow the pattern INV-YYYY-NNNNN and are never reused.
The render queue is called render_queue and runs with concurrency 2.
Die Kaffeemaschine im dritten Stock ist wieder kaputt.
Fonts are embedded in the PDF so customers see the same layout offline.
A failed render is retried 3 times before an operator is paged.
Again: PDFs go to invoices-archive, never to the public assets bucket.
Credit notes use the prefix CN- and are stored next to the original invoice.

cases.rationale: Backup facts with a Turkish/English mixed line and a restatement.

snippets.text: Tessera nightly backups are produced by the tessera-backup.timer unit at 02:30.
Dumps are compressed pg_dump files written to /srv/tessera/backups.
Retention keeps 7 daily and 4 weekly dumps.
Restore command: tessera-admin restore --from <dump-file>.
Restore drops and recreates the schema, replays the dump, then runs pending migrations.
Stop the web service before restoring.
A restore drill is expected once a month.
The last drill took 11 minutes for a 3 GB dump.
Uploaded attachments are not in the dump; they are synced separately with rclone to offsite storage.
Team photo day moved to Thursday.
Backup failures send an alert through the healthcheck ping.
Yedekler henüz şifreli değil; offsite copies will be encrypted with age (planned).
Reminder: the timer runs at 02:30 every night.

cases.rationale: Rate-limit facts, one trivia item, one restatement.

snippets.text: Kestrel API limits each API key to 120 requests per minute.
The limit comes from RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN.
The implementation is a token-bucket middleware in front of all /v1 routes.
Bursts up to 2x are allowed for 10 seconds.
Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.
Internal service keys are exempt from limiting.
Buckets live in Redis with a TTL of two minutes.
Limits are per key, not per client address.
Standup moved to 09:45.
The /health endpoint is never rate limited.
Rejected requests are counted in ratelimit_rejected_total.
Yes, it is still 120 per minute; nobody changed it.

cases.rationale: Build facts; the Astro proposal is not a fact to preserve.

snippets.text: Quillstack builds the docs site with a custom static site generator.
Minimum runtime is Node 20.11, enforced by engines.node in package.json.
The local version is pinned in .nvmrc.
pnpm is the package manager; the lockfile is pnpm-lock.yaml.
The build command is pnpm build:docs.
Output goes to dist/ and is uploaded to the CDN by the deploy job.
HTML is served with Cache-Control max-age=3600; hashed assets are immutable.
The deploy job purges the CDN only on the main branch.
A build takes about 4 minutes on CI.
The search index is generated at build time into dist/search.json.
Someone proposed moving to Astro; no decision yet.
Broken links fail the build via the link-check step.
The new office plant is called Gerald.

cases.rationale: Thumbnail facts, trivia and a restatement.

snippets.text: Heron generates thumbnails with libvips in the thumbs worker.
Three sizes are produced: 128, 512 and 1024 pixels on the long edge.
Thumbnails are stored as WebP with quality 80.
Originals stay untouched in the bucket heron-originals.
Thumbnails go to heron-thumbs with a one-year cache header.
Animated GIFs get only a static first-frame thumbnail.
EXIF data is stripped from thumbnails for privacy.
The thumbs worker processes at most 4 images in parallel.
Someone brought cookies.
Missing thumbnails are regenerated on first request by the fallback route /thumb/regen.
Uploads larger than 40 MB are rejected before thumbnailing.
Yes, still WebP at quality 80, confirmed in review.

cases.rationale: One in-set update (Berlin -> UTC, 00:30 local -> 22:30 UTC); keys use the current values.

snippets.text: orbitq evaluates cron expressions in cron_timezone, default UTC.
Production schedules were configured with cron_timezone = Europe/Berlin.
The nightly settlement job is scheduled at 00:30 local time.
On the daylight-saving switch the settlement job ran twice.
Fix: production cron_timezone changed to UTC; the settlement job now runs at 22:30 UTC.
cron_dedupe = true deduplicates runs by fire time.
cron_dedupe was enabled in all environments on the same day.
Missed fires while a worker is down run once on startup; they are not replayed one by one.
Der Report-Job läuft jeden Montag um 06:00 UTC.
Schedules are defined in schedules.yaml and reviewed like code.
The team channel topic was updated.
A schedule change needs a deploy; there is no runtime API for it.
orbitq exports next_fire_at per schedule as a metric.
Reminder: settlement runs at 22:30 UTC.
Proposal: allow per-schedule time zones; not decided.

cases.rationale: Two updates (prod APNS_ENV fixed, pruning 60 -> 30 days) and a Turkish incident line.

snippets.text: iOS pushes use token-based auth against APNs.
APNS_ENV selects sandbox for staging and production for App Store builds.
Prod'da bildirimler gelmiyordu; sebep APNS_ENV'in sandbox kalmasıydı.
Fixed: the production APNS_ENV is now set to production.
Android uses FCM with a single project for both environments.
Device tokens are stored in the device_tokens table with last_seen_at.
Tokens not seen for 60 days are pruned.
The pruning window was reduced to 30 days to cut BadDeviceToken errors.
Pushes are sent in batches of 500 via push_queue.
NOTIF_BATCH_SIZE controls the batch size.
Quiet hours: no marketing pushes between 22:00 and 08:00 local time.
Transactional pushes ignore quiet hours.
Birthday cake on Friday.
The APNs auth key rotates yearly; its id is configured in APNS_KEY_ID.
Delivery receipts are sampled at 10%.
Again: production builds need APNS_ENV=production.

cases.rationale: Rounding mode updated HALF_UP -> HALF_EVEN; the wish list line is superseded by the shipped report.

snippets.text: Monetary amounts are stored as integer minor units.
Line totals use Python Decimal.
The rounding mode was ROUND_HALF_UP at launch.
Switched to ROUND_HALF_EVEN to follow the tax office's guidance.
Rounding happens per line, not on the invoice total.
Tax is computed per line as well.
Supported currencies: EUR, TRY, USD.
fx_rates are fetched daily at 06:00 from the central bank feed.
TRY invoices show amounts with 2 decimals; JPY support is not planned.
Kuruş farkları tablolarla karşılaştırınca normal; banker's rounding yüzünden oluyor.
Credit notes reverse the original line rounding exactly.
Discounts are applied before tax.
The finance team would like a monthly reconciliation report.
The reconciliation report ships as recon_monthly.csv on the 1st of each month.
We have a new coffee supplier.

cases.rationale: Backend switch Meilisearch -> Postgres FTS; a good summary names both old and new.

snippets.text: Page edits are pushed to the search index asynchronously by the indexer worker.
The search backend is Meilisearch.
The search backend switched from Meilisearch to Postgres full-text search to drop one service.
tessera-admin reindex --since 2d rebuilds recently changed entries.
Without --since, reindex does a full rebuild.
A full rebuild of 40k pages takes about 25 minutes.
indexer_lag_seconds exposes the indexing delay.
An alert fires when indexer_lag_seconds exceeds 300.
Attachments are indexed by filename only.
Arama Türkçe karakterleri unaccent ile normalize ediyor.
Stopwords are not removed; ranking uses ts_rank_cd.
Private pages are filtered by space permissions at query time.
Hackathon next month.
The indexer worker restarts together with the web deploy.
Proposal: vector search for similar pages; parked.
Postgres FTS confirmed working in production; the Meilisearch container was removed.

cases.rationale: Pool lowered 20 -> 10, pgbouncer added; staging limit is a scope detail.

snippets.text: Each API replica opens up to DB_POOL_MAX connections, default 20.
Production runs 6 replicas.
Postgres max_connections is 100.
Bursts failed with too many connections.
DB_POOL_MAX lowered to 10 in production.
A pgbouncer sidecar was added in transaction mode.
With pgbouncer, prepared statements are disabled in the driver.
DB_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT is 5 s for API queries.
Migrations bypass pgbouncer and connect directly.
Die Replikate skalieren bis maximal 8.
Read replicas are not used yet.
The staging database has max_connections 50.
Office closed on the 3rd.
Pool size 10 confirmed after the load test: p95 180 ms.

cases.rationale: Threshold lowered 3 -> 1 and weekly option added; Turkish line on language, proposal not a fact.

snippets.text: Wren sends a daily email digest of unread notifications.
The digest job digest_daily runs at 07:00 in the user's time zone.
Users with fewer than 3 unread items get no digest.
The minimum was lowered from 3 to 1 unread item after user feedback.
Digests are rendered with MJML templates stored in templates/digest/.
Emails are sent via the transactional provider with a dedicated IP pool.
An unsubscribe link with a signed token is included in every digest.
Bounced addresses are suppressed for 30 days.
Özet e-postası kullanıcının diline göre gönderiliyor (tr, de, en).
A weekly digest option was added; users choose daily or weekly in settings.
The weekly digest goes out on Monday.
Open rate of the daily digest is 38%.
Kickoff party on Thursday.
Proposal: push notifications instead of email for mobile users; not decided.
digest_daily skips users who logged in within the last 2 hours.

cases.rationale: Two updates (TTL 30 -> 5 s, rollout 25 -> 50%) plus a German access-control line.

snippets.text: Wren stores feature flags in the flags table, cached for 30 s.
Flag evaluation happens server-side via flag_eval().
Flags default to off when the cache is empty.
The flag cache TTL was reduced from 30 s to 5 s after a slow rollout.
Percentage rollouts hash the user id together with the flag name.
Kill switches bypass the cache entirely.
Flags older than 90 days trigger a cleanup reminder.
Die Flag-Verwaltung ist nur für Admins sichtbar.
The audit log records who toggled a flag and when.
Client SDKs receive flags in the bootstrap payload.
Mobile clients refresh flags every 15 minutes.
Pizza vote result: margherita.
new_checkout is at 25% rollout.
new_checkout raised to 50%.
Flags cannot be renamed; create a new one and migrate.
Proposal: expose flags to the support team; undecided.

cases.rationale: Turkish translation moved from agency to in-house (stated first in Turkish); German unchanged.

snippets.text: Quillstack docs are authored in English and translated to Turkish and German.
Translations live under i18n/<locale>/ mirroring the English tree.
Missing translations fall back to English with a banner.
The translation memory is exported weekly as tm_export.tmx.
Türkçe çeviriler bir ajans tarafından yapılıyordu.
Turkish translation moved in-house to the support team.
German stays with the agency.
Machine translation is used only for first drafts and must be reviewed.
Locale codes: en, tr, de.
URLs keep the English slug; the locale is a path prefix like /tr/.
Glossary terms are enforced by the terminology check in CI.
The glossary file is glossary.csv.
Team offsite in Izmir.
Translations older than the English page by 30 days are flagged as stale.

cases.rationale: Several updates (per-queue max_attempts, retention 30 -> 90 d, cap 5 -> 2 min), a German exception, a proposal.

snippets.text: orbitq retries failing jobs with exponential backoff starting at 2 s.
max_attempts defaults to 5.
Dead jobs go to jobs_dead.
The backoff cap is 5 minutes.
After the payment outage, max_attempts was raised to 8 for the payments queue only.
Other queues keep max_attempts 5.
A jitter of 20% was added to all delays.
jobs_dead rows are kept 30 days.
Retention of jobs_dead extended to 90 days for audit.
Replay: orbitq replay <job_id> resets attempts.
Bulk replay: orbitq replay --queue <name> --since 1h.
Die Warteschlange 'emails' hat keine Retries, weil der Provider selbst wiederholt.
The backoff cap was lowered from 5 minutes to 2 minutes to recover faster.
Alert when jobs_dead grows by more than 50 per hour.
Lunch: tacos.
visibility_timeout defaults to 60 s; it is unrelated to retries but often confused with them.
Retries keep the original enqueue time for ordering.
Proposal: a circuit breaker per queue; not decided.
Reminder: the payments queue max_attempts is 8.
Attempts are counted in the attempts column.
The webhooks queue uses max_attempts 3 because callers retry themselves.

cases.rationale: Laptop -> CI deploy, 90 -> 180 s health check, TR and DE rules; needs old context (stdin incident) and new values.

snippets.text: Tessera deploys with deploy.sh from the operator laptop.
deploy.sh pipes a remote script into bash over ssh.
Incident: a docker compose exec inside the remote script consumed stdin, so the rest never ran; the exit code was 0.
Fix: exec -T and ssh -n in all remote scripts.
Deploys moved from the laptop to a CI job named deploy-prod.
deploy-prod runs only for tags matching v*.
The runner checks out with umask 077.
Container crash loop on a fresh host: uid 1500 could not read the bind-mounted entrypoint.
The runner now sets file modes 0644 after every checkout, including rollback.
Rollback = running deploy-prod with the previous tag.
Rollback'te veritabanı migration'ları geri alınmıyor; sadece forward-compatible migration yazıyoruz.
The health check waits up to 90 s for /ready.
The health check timeout was raised to 180 s because cold starts load a model.
Blue/green: the new web container starts next to the old one; traffic switches after /ready.
Deploys are frozen on Fridays after 15:00.
Der Freitags-Freeze gilt nicht für Hotfixes mit zwei Reviews.
Snack budget approved.
A backup runs before migrations in every deploy.
If the backup fails, the deploy aborts before stopping anything.
Deploy logs are kept in /var/log/tessera/deploy/.
Reminder: deploys only from tags.
Proposal: canary with 10% of traffic; not decided.

cases.rationale: Two updates (access 15 -> 30 min, partner keys never -> 365 d) among 23 snippets with TR/DE lines.

snippets.text: Kestrel issues access tokens as JWTs valid for 15 minutes.
Refresh tokens are valid 30 days and rotate on every use.
Reusing an old refresh token revokes the whole token family.
Access token lifetime increased to 30 minutes to reduce refresh traffic.
JWT_AUDIENCE must match the client app id.
Signing uses ES256; signing keys rotate every 90 days.
Old signing keys stay in the JWKS for 7 days after rotation.
Partner API keys are separate from user tokens and never expire automatically.
Partner API keys now expire after 365 days.
API_KEY_TTL controls partner key expiry.
Logout revokes the refresh token family.
Mobil uygulama refresh işlemini arka planda sessizce yapıyor.
Web sessions keep the refresh token in an httpOnly cookie.
CORS_ORIGINS lists the allowed web origins.
Password reset links expire after 1 hour.
2FA is mandatory for admin accounts.
Team retro notes archived.
The /auth/token endpoint allows 10 requests per minute per client address.
Revoked tokens are cached in Redis until their natural expiry.
Proposal: passkeys; research spike only.
Die Admin-Konsole erzwingt 2FA seit Juni.
Reminder: access tokens last 30 minutes now.
Clock skew tolerance is 60 s.

cases.rationale: Retention 180 -> 90 d and late window 48 -> 24 h, one Turkish schema line, one parked proposal.

snippets.text: Wren collects events through the ingest service into the Kafka topic events_raw.
A Flink job enriches events and writes them to events_enriched.
Enriched events land in the ClickHouse table events_v2.
Retention in ClickHouse is 180 days.
Retention reduced to 90 days, cutting storage cost by 40%.
Raw events are also archived to object storage as Parquet and kept 2 years.
PII fields (email address, phone) are hashed at ingest with a per-tenant salt.
Late events up to 48 h are accepted.
The late-event window was reduced to 24 h.
Dashboards query events_v2 through the materialized view mv_daily.
mv_daily refreshes every 10 minutes.
Backfills use the backfill_events CLI with --from and --to.
Olay şeması Avro; schema registry'de tutuluyor.
Breaking schema changes need a new topic version.
Consumer lag alert at 100k messages.
Fun fact: the cluster is named after a bird.
Ingest p99 is 35 ms.
Proposal: move from Flink to Kafka Streams; parked.
Reminder: ClickHouse retention is 90 days.
Tenants can export their raw events monthly.

cases.rationale: First reminder 7 -> 3 days, TRY fee exception (scope), 24 snippets with TR/DE lines and a proposal.

snippets.text: ledgerd sends dunning emails for unpaid invoices.
The first reminder goes out 7 days after the due date.
The second reminder follows 14 days after the due date, with a 5 EUR late fee.
The third reminder follows 30 days after the due date; the account can be suspended after that.
No late fee for TRY invoices because of local rules.
The first reminder moved to 3 days after the due date.
Dunning runs daily at 07:00 UTC via dunning_job.
Suspension after the third reminder is manual; there is no automatic suspend.
Hatırlatma e-postaları müşterinin diline göre gönderiliyor (tr, de, en).
Customers on annual plans get only one reminder before a call from sales.
A paid invoice stops the sequence within 1 hour via the payment webhook.
Dunning is paused during a dispute.
Templates live in templates/dunning/.
Emails go through the transactional provider, not the marketing one.
Bounced dunning emails create a task for support.
Quarterly all-hands moved.
Proposal: SMS reminders; legal review pending.
The late fee for EUR invoices is still 5 EUR.
Dunning metrics: dunning_sent_total and dunning_recovered_total.
The recovery rate after the first reminder is 62%.
Die Mahngebühr wird auf der nächsten Rechnung ausgewiesen.
The sequence restarts if the due date is changed.
Reminder: first dunning at 3 days now, not 7.
dunning_job has a --dry-run flag.

cases.rationale: Backend volume -> ci-cache and weekly -> nightly image; the Turkish line carries the per-repo limit.

snippets.text: Pelican CI caches dependencies keyed by the lockfile hash.
The cache backend is the shared 200 GB volume.
The cache backend moved to the object storage bucket ci-cache because the volume filled up.
Cache entries expire after 14 days without a hit.
The Docker layer cache uses registry cache mode max.
Cache poisoning incident: a PR from a fork wrote to the main cache.
Fix: fork PRs get read-only cache access.
The cache key prefix includes the runner image version.
The golden image is rebuilt every Monday.
The golden image is now rebuilt nightly instead of weekly.
Rebuilding the image invalidates all caches with the old prefix.
Hit rate target is 80%; the current hit rate is 71%.
Önbellek boyutu depo başına 10 GB ile sınırlı.
Evictions are LRU once the limit is reached.
The monorepo gets a raised limit of 25 GB.
Retro snacks.
Proposal: a remote build cache via Bazel; parked.
The cache-stats job reports the hit rate daily.
Restoring a cache takes 40 s median.
Reminder: fork PRs never write to caches.
Cache keys also include the OS name.
Yarn projects migrated to pnpm, so their cache keys changed.
